csv_order_batch_reconstruction.basis: Existing per-image CSV order, batch size 4, shuffle=false; no image or mask content read
csv_order_batch_reconstruction.interpretation: The reconstruction proves the checkpoint value was not an equal-weight mean of batch means. It cannot reproduce the original batched-inference logits because the CSV was produced later by single-image inference. The small checkpoint-versus-CSV difference is attributable to numerically different batched versus single-image AMP/CUDA inference paths plus floating-point reduction, not aggregation weighting.

epoch_artifact_audit.note: An interrupted corrupt latest artifact is not a valid epoch checkpoint and provides no recoverable scientific evidence.

scientific_decision.evidence: history.csv contains the protocol-correct sample-level macro scalar for every epoch. Epoch 47 is its maximum. Epochs 48-62 are exactly 15 consecutive non-improvements under the same scalar.
